videos.title: Introduction To Undertsanding RAG(Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
videos.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is the process of optimizing the output of a large language model, so it references an authoritative knowledge base outside of its training data sources before generating a response. Large Language Models (LLMs) are trained on vast volumes of data and use billions of parameters to generate original output for tasks like answering questions, translating languages, and completing sentences. RAG extends the already powerful capabilities of LLMs to specific domains or an organization's internal knowledge base, all without the need to retrain the model. It is a cost-effective approach to improving LLM output so it remains relevant, accurate, and useful in various contexts. ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Check our Complete Playlist Agentic AI Langgraph Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vVGXPRjtAJE&list=PLZoTAELRMXVPFd7JdvB-rnTb_5V26NYNO RAG Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fZM3oX4xEyg&list=PLZoTAELRMXVM8Pf4U67L4UuDRgV4TNX9D MCP Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-UQ6OZywZ2I&list=PLZoTAELRMXVPC8r1xF68Gksi241DAtMsK

We'll break down the papers to understand how researchers are identifying and manipulating the very vectors that control these complex personality traits.  By the end of this video, you'll understand: * The core mechanism behind Anthropic's "Persona Vectors" * How this technique relates (sometimes tangentially) to other research works * The potential this unlocks for creating safer, more reliable, and precisely controlled AI systems.   ### ABOUT THE CHANNEL  My channel is for "The AI Builder": the developer, tinkerer, and hands-on enthusiast.
